newsitem.title: USA: Houghton Mifflin says declares 2-for-1 split.
newsitem.headline: Houghton Mifflin says declares 2-for-1 split.

text.p: Houghton Mifflin Co said Wednesday its board declared a two-for-one split of its common stock, to come in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend.
The company said the record date for the dividend is July 11. It will be distributed July 25.
The company said there will be about 30 million shares outstanding following the stock split.
Houghton Mifflin is a publisher of textbooks and other educational materials for the elementary and secondary school and college markets.
